title: Fixed Twin Belt Table and Offset Film Mast Wrapper
description: One newly authored whole empty towable bale-wrapper-style apparatus in a fixed parked display. A complete twin-wheel open chassis, converging draw beams, empty tow eye and front parking sole carry a raised central turntable-style hub and full rectangular support frame. Two whole closed broad belt loops extend around two complete end drums and form the empty table cradle. Paired side bobbin rollers rise from two full support arms. A separate offset corner mast carries a complete upper and lower dispenser bracket, one opaque film-roll-shaped body with central through hole, spindle and two slender guide rollers. The rear chassis has a closed plain control housing. No bale, loose film sheet, tractor or loading device included; this generic externally loaded display has no self-loading arm. Not the old floor-mounted round pallet wrapper or chamber/pickup baler; all mesh coordinates newly authored. One model zero scenes, opaque PBR only. No rotation, wrapping, belt drive, film feed, film tension, tipping, clamping, hydraulic mechanism, lift, coupling compatibility, load, machine operation, engineering, manufacture or safety capability made or verified. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
